objective: Recover actual historical abbreviation expansions conservatively as a component toward decipherment; retain unknowns and do not treat this known-alphabet task as Voynich success.
prior_exposure: Article, metadata and five training examples read. Only training rules inspected. No held-out target printed or scored before freeze. Preliminary unrestricted marked-sign fitting was replaced during development by visible-letter preservation after implausible training rules were observed.
data: 1879 public PEN test rows at pinned revision. All are the published curated test set, not the automatic training set. Latin/French only for modeling;3 und rows retained in source but excluded. Published paper describes588 original alignments whereas downloadable file contains1879 rows; they are not counted as1879 independent manuscripts.
groups: Strip final8hex alignment suffix from archive manuscript IDs; group paramhtrs by directory shelfmark; group all four alto files together as one unspecified volume. These are derived document groups, not an independent historical catalog. Same works or phrases may recur across manuscripts.
split: Hold out all path-based GT collection records, plus archive groups whose SHA256(phase39:+group) first8hex modulo5 is0. Remaining groups train. Hash assignment based only on source identifiers; exact source duplicates across splits are reported after scoring, not counted as independent evidence.
normalization: Lowercase NFD; v/u to u, j/i to i, long s to s, ae/oe ligatures expanded. Tokenizer retains Unicode letters, combining marks, ampersand, Tironian et and private abbreviation U+F1AC; other punctuation separates words. Reference targets strip combining marks. No claim of recovering editorial capitalization, spelling distinctions or punctuation.
word_alignment: SequenceMatcher with autojunk=False on source and target tokens. Equal blocks, or1-3token equal-length replacements bracketed by exact token matches. This is our inferred word alignment, not manually validated token alignment. Unaligned predictions are counted separately, never counted correct.
fit: For aligned marked words with ASCII targets, retain all segmentations. Ordinary a-z units fixed. Marked/sign units may produce0..8 letters but must preserve their visible ASCII base and combining superscript letters in order, inferred from Unicode names. Only unique segmentations add sign-rule evidence. Up to128 paths; overflow excludes training rule extraction. Word evidence requires at least one admissible segmentation.
learner: Pooled Latin/French. Preserve all learned values and their distinct training document groups. Decode with values supported by at least2 groups, union with equally supported full-word values. Weak alternatives remain recorded but not used by decoder; their exclusion can cause errors and must be tested. No dictionary filter or language-model choice.
decoding: Ordinary unmarked strings unchanged. Missing supported sign value abstains. Enumerate all admissible readings up to4096 then abstain on overflow. Emit only one remaining string; otherwise abstain. No target text passed to expansion.
comparators: Whole-word memorization with2group support; and at most2 free insertions into the visible-letter skeleton with training-only lexicon, pooling both languages. Same held-out aligned marked tokens. Neither comparator is a faithful replication of phase38 prefix rules.
outcomes: Precision and coverage on paired marked tokens; candidate recall; seen/unseen word forms; unscored marked and accepted tokens; full source denominators; Latin/French and source-origin summaries. No rates are percentages of Voynich deciphered.
component_gate: For each Latin and French: at least30 scored emissions, precision>=0.95 and coverage>=0.20 among scored marked tokens. This operational gate concerns only paired token expansions; unscored emissions prevent claiming complete document validation.
voynich_boundary: No application to Voynich in this phase: glyph-to-abbreviation mapping, language and unknown-key recovery remain unestablished. A component pass does not authorize declaring plaintext. This is not Italian-language validation of the phase38 proposal.
verification: Second implementation recomputes predictions and scoring, source conversion checked against Parquet, group disjointness, byte-identical replay. Same operator, no new human philological review.
delivery: Local only; preserve earlier phases. Full user goal remains active.
